physicalNotes: Install U1 with pin 1 at F10 and set its internal clock to 8 MHz without division. RV1 wiper goes to A0 and D9 drives J2.
Use the regulated 5 V supply at J1 and connect the servo to J2 by signal name. Connect C4 positive to H29 and negative to H27 using insulated pigtails.
